name: Microsoft Natural Ergonomic Keyboard 4000
notes: 60-byte report descriptor of the keyboard interface (interface 0) of a real Microsoft Natural Ergonomic Keyboard 4000, read with usbhid-dump from the device: https://forums.freebsd.org/threads/keyboard-special-keys-not-being-detected.98361/. Other interfaces of the real device are not part of this profile.
